verify.note: The default has no hook: boot checks and the ROM path check over every recording. Enhanced: every recording replayed, at every hook the hook against the original from the same state, every register with R, all 48K RAM but the dead stack, MMU and clock; every published Layer 2 window against an independent plane model, a second model on the mono bytes against the buffer and the ULA; ABI cases on lv1's first 900 frames; 14 broken builds on them (one that survives is run over the other recordings in full). Pace, soak, flicker and the real loader are in games/scooby_doo.md "Evidence".
